key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1636
name: map_channel_code_to_mask
description: Reads a 16-bit code from the input record and, for codes 5 to 8, stores the matching mask (4, 8, 2 or 1) in a global, then writes one and zero to a second global and clears a per-entry byte. Any other code returns without changing anything.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1658
name: set_audio_channel_zero_state
description: Its facts list writes to the first audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, but the pseudo-code shown only sets a global to one, then to zero, and clears a memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:167C
name: set_audio_channel_one_state
description: Its facts list writes to the second audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, but the pseudo-code shown only sets a global to two, then one, then zero, and clears a memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:16A0
name: set_audio_channel_two_state
description: Its facts list writes to the third audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, but the pseudo-code shown only sets a global to four, then one, then zero, and clears a memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:16C4
name: set_audio_channel_three_state
description: Its facts list writes to the fourth audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, but the pseudo-code shown only sets a global to eight, then one, then zero, and clears a memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:16E8
name: disable_audio_channel_zero
description: Its facts list writes to the first audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, and the pseudo-code shows only a global set to one and then to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1702
name: disable_audio_channel_one
description: Its facts list writes to the second audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, and the pseudo-code shows only a global set to two, then one, then zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:171C
name: disable_audio_channel_two
description: Its facts list writes to the third audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, and the pseudo-code shows only a global set to four, then one, then zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1736
name: disable_audio_channel_three
description: Its facts list writes to the fourth audio channel's period, volume and DMA control registers, and the pseudo-code shows only a global set to eight, then one, then zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1750
name: fetch_sequence_word_with_offset
description: Stores a one in a record field, copies the next word from a sequence pointer into the record and advances the pointer, stepping back first when that word is 255. When a second global is non-zero it writes the word minus that offset, clamped at zero, otherwise it writes the word unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:1762
name: fetch_indirect_sequence_word
description: Takes the next 4-byte pointer from a table in the record and reads its first word as a command code; for a non-zero code it copies the code and following fields into the record and then returns a sequence word using the same offset and step-back rules as the direct sequence reader.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26314
name: clear_flag_and_call
description: Clears a byte in the record at a fixed offset, calls another routine, then sets a global to one and returns that call's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:2632E
name: call_routine_and_set_flag
description: Calls another routine, sets a global flag to one afterwards, and returns the two register results of that call to the caller unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26346
name: find_first_active_slot
description: Clears a bit in a status byte and, if that bit was set, calls another routine twice; it then searches an eight-entry table of slot bytes for the first non-zero entry, stores its index plus one in a word, and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:263CE
name: set_flag_from_zero_test
description: Stores minus one into one record byte when another record byte is zero, and zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:263D2
name: store_zero_flag_mask
description: Stores minus one into one record byte when the processor zero flag is set, and zero otherwise, without reading any other data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:263D8
name: reset_slot_index_and_dispatch
description: Sets a word field in the record to minus one, clears a byte, zeroes a global, sets another global to nine and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26402
name: forward_value_when_enabled
description: When one record flag is set, it returns early if the input is 20 and a second flag is clear; otherwise it clears a global, stores the input in a global and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26432
name: store_value_and_call_router
description: Stores the incoming 32-bit value into a global variable and then calls another routine with no further work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26448
name: clamp_count_and_forward
description: When a record flag is set, caps the count word at 63, and if the count is non-zero clears a global, stores the value and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:26476
name: call_handler_when_slot_unset
description: When a record flag is set and the slot word is negative, it calls another routine; otherwise it returns without action.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:2649E
name: dispatch_value_below_fifteen
description: When a record flag is set, the input byte is below 15 and a non-zero word in the record is present, it clears a global, stores the 32-bit input in a global and calls another routine; otherwise it returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:264E6
name: set_status_byte_minus_one
description: Stores minus one into one status byte of the record and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:3:264EE
name: reset_or_find_active_slot
description: When a record flag is clear, it resets the slot word, clears a byte, zeroes a global, sets another global to nine and calls another routine. When the flag is set it clears a status bit, may call a routine twice, then searches the eight-entry slot table for the first non-zero entry and calls another routine with its index plus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:7:5024
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of the input register unchanged, with no memory or call activity.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:7:5EC2
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of the input register unchanged; the facts list one call to another routine, but the pseudo-code shows only the return.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:7:5EF2
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Does nothing and returns at once; the pseudo-code contains only a return, so it is an empty stub.

name: return_input_byte_unchanged

name: return_input_byte_unchanged

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:8:442A
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of the input register unchanged, with no memory or call activity.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:3BAC
name: call_jump_table_sequence
description: Calls six routines in order through function pointers stored at fixed offsets of a table held in an address register, with one direct call between them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:3C40
name: iterate_and_call_table_entries
description: Loops over a table whose count sits in the record, calling two function pointers per entry with a running index and a stepped value that wraps back at 157, and advances the entry pointer by 28 bytes each pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:53AA
name: drain_counted_passes_type_three
description: Returns early unless the input byte is 3; otherwise it calls a function pointer, then calls a routine once for each count returned by a counter function over several passes, skipping one pass when a record flag is set and capping another count at 25.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:58A8
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Does nothing and returns at once; the pseudo-code contains only a return, so it is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:58AA
name: drain_counted_passes_type_three
description: Returns early unless the input byte is 3; otherwise it calls a function pointer, then calls a routine once for each count returned by a counter function over several passes, skipping one pass when a record flag is set and capping another count at 25.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5960
name: scale_and_add_offset_pair
description: Sets two record bytes to fixed constants, then adds a counter result scaled by four to a stored 64-bit value and writes the sum back into the record. It then calls another routine, and branches to one of two handlers depending on whether the sum is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:59B6
name: jump_through_handler_slot
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a jump table held in an address register and returns; it is a single-call trampoline.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:59BC
name: copy_record_fields_and_offset
description: Copies either one byte or a block of record fields depending on a flag bit, then writes a counter-derived value and a 64-bit offset into the record. It finishes by calling one of two handlers chosen by a second flag bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:59F8
name: apply_scaled_offset_and_branch
description: Adds a counter result scaled by sixteen and a 64-bit offset into the record, sets two bytes to fixed constants, then calls one of two handlers depending on a flag bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5A82
name: jump_through_alternate_handler_slot
description: Calls a function pointer stored at a different jump-table slot in an address register and returns; it is a single-call trampoline.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5A88
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Does nothing and returns at once; the pseudo-code contains only a return, so it is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5A8A
name: handle_count_result_branches
description: Calls a function to get a count: when it is zero, it calls two routines and writes 20 into a record byte; when the count is above one, it returns count minus one; when it is one, it calls routines, writes 20, and adds 100000 then 200000 to a 32-bit record field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5AA0
name: store_byte_and_call_pair
description: When a flag result from a first routine is clear, it stores the caller's byte into a record field, calls a second routine, writes 20 into another record field and calls a third routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5AC8
name: store_byte_and_add_totals
description: When a flag result from a first routine is clear, it stores the caller's byte and the constant 20 into two record fields, then adds 100000 and later 200000 to a 32-bit record field, calling routines between the steps.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5B28
name: fetch_table_word_into_record
description: Calls a function pointer, uses its result masked to 30 plus the caller's offset to index a global word table, stores that word as a 32-bit value in the record, and writes 251 into a second record byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5B6E
name: store_flag_and_copy_byte
description: When the zero flag is clear, it calls a routine and returns early if that routine's flag is set; otherwise it writes minus one into one record field, calls a routine, writes 44 into a second field and copies a byte from another record into a third.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5BB2
name: decode_symbol_into_byte_run
description: Stores the input byte as a code, calls two routines and reads counts from a stream through a function pointer, then fills a run of record bytes with one table value and stores a remaining-count field and a mode mask. The character codes for newline, form feed and backspace select different starting counts and flags, and the routine returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5BB6
name: decode_symbol_into_byte_run
description: Stores the input byte as a code, calls an object method, then does the same decoding as its neighbour: reads counts from a stream, fills a run of record bytes with one table value and stores a remaining-count field and a mode mask. The character codes for newline, form feed and backspace select different starting counts and flags, and the routine returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5C80
name: fill_byte_run_from_code
description: Takes the high byte of the input word as a code, derives a remaining count from a table-driven subtraction, reads further counts from a stream and fills a run of record bytes with one table value, then stores the remaining counter and a mode mask and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5D04
name: finish_byte_run_fill
description: Finishes a byte-run fill by reading a final count, adding mode flags when that count is above 2047 or the input exceeds 16383, and storing the remaining counter and mode mask into the record before returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5DF4
name: find_threshold_table_index
description: Calls a function pointer for a value, combines it with a record byte and a global table entry, multiplies the result by the input word and scans a word table upward until an entry reaches that threshold, then returns the matching table byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5E20
name: call_four_subroutines
description: Calls one other routine four times in succession and then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5E34
name: store_result_and_check_threshold
description: Stores the high half of a method's result into a record field and calls a second method; when that result is above three it calls a third method and, if its value is non-negative, stores it and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns the low half of the first result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5E8E
name: check_flag_and_call
description: If a 16-bit flag in the global record is non-zero, it calls two function pointers and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5EB4
name: scan_bit_flag_loop
description: When a record word is non-zero, it takes a count from a function and steps through a table of record bytes, 474 bytes at a time, decrementing the count until one byte has the bit of value 16 set. It returns minus one if such a byte was found, otherwise zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5ED6
name: store_result_and_call
description: Calls a method and stores its 32-bit result in a record field, then calls a second method on another object and returns the original register values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:9:5EF8
name: clear_structure_fields
description: Calls two function pointers, then sets one 32-bit and one 16-bit record field to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:11:385A
name: clear_field_return_input_byte
description: Clears one 32-bit field of the record and returns the input byte unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)[a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De)[a].adf:Frontier:11:388E
name: clear_record_long_field
description: Sets one 32-bit field of the record to zero and returns with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:c/Stack:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: If the output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a table in the record into that buffer, then calls a function pointer and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:0:0000
name: run_entry_with_optional_cleanup
description: Program entry point: it clears a flag, calls a table entry to obtain a task-like structure and, when a field in it is zero, runs two calls and stores the result in the flag. It then calls another routine and runs two cleanup calls when the flag is set; the Amiga exec calls named in the facts are not visible in the pseudo-code, which shows only table lookups.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:0:006E
name: run_timed_input_loop
description: After a setup sequence of routine calls and pointer stores, it loops forever: it advances a 32-bit counter, reads an input byte and, when that byte is one of the codes 49 to 53 or the counter passes a large limit, runs cleanup calls and resets its state. Otherwise it waits on a flag and calls routines to update the timing and display state.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:13C94
name: claim_slot_and_advance_counter
description: When the counter is below 248 and the slot byte at the given index is free, it stores the counter in the slot and in a word table entry, advances the counter by four and returns the counter value. Otherwise it returns the slot's current byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:13CAA
name: store_slot_entry_if_room
description: If the counter is below 248, it writes the index byte into a table at the counter position, stores the index and counter together as a word in a global table and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:13CBC
name: store_entry_and_advance_counter
description: Writes the input byte into a table at the given index, stores the input word and index as a word in a list at the pointer, and advances the counter word at that pointer by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:13D0E
name: partition_and_sort_entries
description: Clears a block of counter-indexed words, then when enough entries exist it copies them into a work buffer with swapped halves and partitions them in place by nibble keys, repeatedly choosing the segment with the largest count. The pseudo-code is truncated, so the final write of the ordered entries is only partly visible.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:13F48
name: calculate_data_bounds
description: Initialises six min and max word fields to minus one, then scans a block of words, splitting each into a high byte and two nibbles to track the minimum and maximum of each part. It stores the three ranges and their sum in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18B52
name: clear_bitplane_block_shifted
description: Chooses left or right shifting from the sign of a shift count, then ANDs the inverted shifted source bits into two columns of four bitplanes over eight rows, with a row stride of 20 words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18B9A
name: clear_bitplane_block_inner
description: Clears bits in four bitplanes over eight rows by ANDing the inverted shifted source byte into the first column, and into the second column when the shift is within range, advancing 20 words per row.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18BE8
name: clear_bitplane_column_bits
description: Loops over a byte array, shifting each byte by a register count and ANDing its inverse into the four bitplane words of one column, advancing the destination by 20 words per byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18C12
name: set_first_plane_clear_others
description: Shifts a source byte by a sign-chosen amount and ORs the bits into the first bitplane of two columns while ANDing their inverse into the other three planes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18C5A
name: set_first_plane_inner
description: ORs shifted source bits into the first bitplane of eight rows and clears the same bits in the other three planes, advancing 20 words per row.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18CA8
name: or_first_and_and_others
description: Loops over a byte array, ORing each shifted source bit into the first bitplane word and ANDing its inverse into the three other planes, advancing 20 words per byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18CD2
name: set_second_plane_clear_others
description: Shifts a source byte by a sign-chosen amount, ORs the bits into the second bitplane of two columns and clears them in the first, third and fourth planes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18D1A
name: set_second_plane_inner
description: ORs shifted source bits into the second bitplane of eight rows, clears them in the other planes, and handles the second column when the shift is within range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18D68
name: and_first_and_or_second
description: Loops over a byte array, ANDing the inverse of each shifted source bit into the first bitplane word and ORing the bit into the second plane while clearing the third and fourth planes, advancing 20 words per byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18D92
name: set_two_planes_shifted
description: Shifts a source byte by a sign-chosen amount and ORs the bits into the first and second bitplanes of two columns, while clearing them in the third and fourth planes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:18DDA
